claim: Patchline ships an autonomy maturity model with measurable levels and gate-backed promotion criteria. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the maturity model claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make autonomy-maturity-model-gate`.
